title: TIDIR Reference Architecture Graph
description: Machine-readable graph representation of TIDIR invariants, capabilities, services, threats, and governance contracts.
maxim: Probabilistic components propose. Deterministic components authorise.

four_planes.data_plane: Line-rate ingestion, streaming buses, and raw lakehouse storage. Untrusted telemetry inputs.
four_planes.analytical_plane: Detection engines, graph correlators, and probabilistic agent meshes. Advisory analysis without inherent authority.
four_planes.defence_control_plane: Security kernel governing policy evaluation, invariant enforcement, blast-radius validation, identity issuance, and emergency E-Stops.
four_planes.actuation_plane: Outbound API connectors, endpoint EDR agents, and identity providers. Task-scoped execution with monotonic reachability guarantees.

invariants.name: Telemetry Preservation
invariants.title: Absence of current detection value does not justify destruction of forensic evidence
invariants.maxim: Absence of current detection value does not justify destruction of forensic evidence.
invariants.property: Ingested telemetry must survive and remain queryable in an open, vendor-neutral, schema-agnostic representation.
invariants.reference_pattern: Line-rate stream ingestion into open columnar lakehouses (e.g. Apache Iceberg / Parquet) on object storage.

invariants.name: Evidence Traceability
invariants.title: Every consequential machine assertion is traceable to underlying raw observations
invariants.maxim: Every consequential machine assertion is traceable to underlying raw observations.
invariants.property: No detection finding, hypothesis, or containment recommendation exists without citation to immutable observation identifiers.
invariants.reference_pattern: source_observation_ids and derivation_chain lineage committed to the Incident Decision DAG.

invariants.name: Evidential Independence
invariants.title: Common ancestry cannot be represented as independent corroboration
invariants.maxim: Common ancestry cannot be represented as independent corroboration.
invariants.property: Correlated derivations sharing common upstream ancestry cannot masquerade as independent evidence; co-derived signals must be discounted.
invariants.reference_pattern: Dependency-aware probabilistic risk compounding (Bayesian graph compounding or factor graphs).

invariants.name: Authority Separation
invariants.title: Probabilistic components propose. Deterministic components authorize
invariants.maxim: Probabilistic components propose. Deterministic components authorize.
invariants.property: Probabilistic models (LLMs, neural embeddings, clustering heuristics) operate strictly in read-only analysis mode.
invariants.reference_pattern: Agent Trust Boundary isolating data plane from control plane; deterministic schema AST validation.

invariants.name: Least Capability & Ephemeral Identity
invariants.title: Machine identities receive only task-scoped, short-lived authority
invariants.maxim: Machine identities receive only task-scoped, short-lived authority.
invariants.property: Machine authority must be short-lived, workload-bound, and strictly task-scoped without ambient API credentials.
invariants.reference_pattern: SPIFFE/SPIRE Verifiable Identity Documents (SVIDs) valid for <= 15 minutes.

invariants.name: Bounded Autonomy & Blast Radius
invariants.title: Autonomous execution is strictly constrained by time, cost, scope, and blast radius
invariants.maxim: Autonomous execution is strictly constrained by time, cost, scope, and blast radius.
invariants.property: Automated actions enforce hard ceilings: wall-clock execution timeouts, financial inference limits, max tool-hops, and asset criticality boundaries.
invariants.reference_pattern: Pre-execution impact simulation with Tier 0 critical asset immunity.

invariants.name: Reachability Monotonicity
invariants.title: Partial failure cannot silently restore attacker reachability (s_{n+1} <= s_n)
invariants.maxim: Partial failure cannot silently restore attacker reachability.
invariants.property: Attacker reachability tuple <R_net, R_id, E_surface, V_telemetry> must not expand upon component or API failure.
invariants.reference_pattern: Monotonic state machines executing forward perimeter escalation rather than rolling back security barriers.

invariants.name: Graceful Defensive Degradation
invariants.title: Failure of an advanced capability reduces sophistication, never total visibility
invariants.maxim: Failure of an advanced capability reduces sophistication, never total visibility.
invariants.property: Outages in advanced streaming or generative AI gates automatically fall back to deterministic and local modes.
invariants.reference_pattern: 4-tier degradation: local edge spooling, scheduled batch lakehouse sweeps, and Zero-AI tabular timelines.

invariants.name: Human Recoverability & Flight Decks
invariants.title: Autonomous control planes always preserve independently accessible manual flight decks
invariants.maxim: Autonomous control planes always preserve independently accessible manual flight decks.
invariants.property: Humans retain permanent out-of-band operational authority via cryptographic master kill-switches.
invariants.reference_pattern: Cryptographic Master E-Stop and authenticated dual-authorization break-glass protocols.

invariants.name: Reconstructability
invariants.title: Consequential decisions can be deterministically reconstructed from immutable records
invariants.maxim: Consequential decisions can be deterministically reconstructed from immutable records.
invariants.property: All triage findings, model inputs, and containment actions are committed to an immutable ledger.
invariants.reference_pattern: Incident Decision DAG sealed with RFC 3161 cryptographic timestamps and WORM storage.

invariants.name: Operational Portability & Exit
invariants.title: Vendor neutrality is an architectural invariant, not merely a design intention
invariants.maxim: Vendor neutrality is an architectural invariant, not merely a design intention.
invariants.property: No consequential security telemetry, detection logic, case state, policy definition, or audit lineage SHALL be irrecoverably dependent upon a proprietary environment.
invariants.reference_pattern: Open standards: OCSF schema, Parquet/Iceberg storage, Polyglot DaC, STIX/TAXII 2.1, and open JSON-LD DAGs.

capabilities.name: Feed Aggregation & Ingestion
capabilities.description: Ingest commercial, open-source, ISAC, and internal telemetry feeds via STIX/TAXII and streaming endpoints.

capabilities.name: Deduplication & Confidence Scoring
capabilities.description: Normalize disparate indicator types, resolve overlapping claims, and compute half-life decay curves.

capabilities.name: Retroactive Sweep (Retro-Hunt)
capabilities.description: Automatically sweep historical lakehouse telemetry upon discovery of novel zero-day IOCs/TTPs.

capabilities.name: Multi-Source Ingestion
capabilities.description: Collect telemetry from host kernel instrumentation, cloud control planes, identity tokens, and network sensors.
capabilities.target_slo: Durable acknowledgement; designed for loss-intolerant ingestion with local buffer failover

capabilities.name: Canonical Schema Normalization
capabilities.description: Coerce raw schema structures into OCSF objects at line rate with structured unmapped_data catch-all.

capabilities.name: Historical Security Lakehouse
capabilities.description: Store long-term telemetry in open columnar formats with partition pruning on object storage.

capabilities.name: Real-Time Stream Detection
capabilities.description: Evaluate sliding-window stateful rules and pattern matches against line-rate event streams.

capabilities.name: Bayesian Multi-Signal Risk Lens
capabilities.description: Compound orthogonal evidence vectors (asset, identity, network) while discounting co-derived signals.

capabilities.name: Agent Mesh & Multi-Model Consensus
capabilities.description: Coordinate specialist subagents with adversarial Proposer/Challenger critique behind the Agent Trust Boundary.

capabilities.name: Monotonic Containment & Forward Escalation
capabilities.description: Fail-secure execution preventing security regression on error; escalates perimeter forward.

services.name: Dynamic Threat Intelligence & Indicator Cache
services.description: Continuous ingestion, normalisation, and automated confidence-decay scoring with in-memory edge matching.

services.name: Automated Retrospective Hunting Sweeps
services.description: Asynchronous 365+ day historical lakehouse scans upon zero-day emergence.

services.name: Universal Ingestion & Line-Rate OCSF Normalisation
services.description: High-throughput collection across host, cloud, and network sensors compiled into canonical OCSF.

services.name: Agentic Triage & Progressive Disclosure Investigation
services.description: Hierarchical agent mesh, Agent Trust Boundary, and progressive Situation Summaries.

services.name: Blast-Radius Gated Containment & Monotonic State Machines
services.description: Pre-execution impact simulation, fail-closed forward escalation, and reachability monotonicity.

threats.name: Sensor Evasion & Telemetry Blinding
threats.description: Attacker unloads kernel sensors, disrupts transport forwarders, or exploits network partitions to evade detection.

threats.name: Schema Poisoning & DoS Inundation
threats.description: Adversary emits malformed payloads or unmapped event floods to exhaust pipeline memory or crash parsers.

threats.name: Evidence Tampering & Audit Destruction
threats.description: Compromised administrator attempts to purge or modify investigative query logs and case dossiers.

threats.name: Indirect Prompt Injection & Cognitive Hijack
threats.description: Adversary embeds malicious control directives inside command line arguments, log files, or CTI reports.

threats.name: Alert Storm DoS & Analyst Desensitisation
threats.description: Adversary generates high-volume weak anomalies across enterprise nodes to induce alert fatigue.

threats.name: Automated Response Sabotage & Self-Inflicted Outage
threats.description: Adversary manipulates defensive playbooks into isolating critical production databases or domain controllers.
